# Axlerate

Axlerate is an online auto parts store. The catalog includes replacement and maintenance parts for popular cars, trucks, and SUVs.

## What the website offers

- A searchable catalog of more than 500 listed parts, including brakes, engines, tires, paint and body parts, doors, cables, cooling, drivetrain, fuel system, ignition, steering, batteries, filters, lighting, and other essentials.
- Vehicle and category filters to help shoppers find parts for makes including Tesla, Toyota, Ford, Honda, Chevrolet, GMC, Ram, Jeep, Hyundai, and Kia.
- Product details with listed fitment, specifications, images, and pricing.
- A part inquiry form for requests that are not currently in the catalog.
- Cart checkout with an option to contact the store by live chat or WhatsApp.

## Store information shown on the website

- Website name: Axlerate
- The website advertises listed parts at 20% below the comparison retail price.
- Standard shipping is free above the threshold shown on the site.
- Unused parts may be returned within 30 days under the published return policy.

## Useful pages

- Home and catalog: /

- Vehicle finder: /#/vehicles

Product availability, fitment, prices, and policies should be confirmed on the live website before making a purchase recommendation.
